Read input: fir128x16x18_internal_combined.v · Open raw
module fir128x16x18_internal (
    input [15:0] cin,
    input [15:0] din,
    input write,
    input load,
    input start,
    output reg [15:0] dout,
    output reg rdy,
    output reg ovf,
    input clk,
    input rst
    );

// Internal registers and signals
reg [15:0] acc, buffer;
reg [6:0] count;

always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        acc <= 0;
        buffer <= 0;
        count <= 0;
        rdy <= 0;
        ovf <= 0;
        dout <= 0;
    end
    else if (write) begin
        buffer <= din;
    end
    else if (load) begin
        acc <= buffer;
    end
    else if (start) begin
        if (count == 0) begin
            dout <= acc;
            rdy <= 1;
        end
        else begin
            count <= count - 1;
            acc <= acc + buffer;  // Simple example of FIR filter accumulation
            rdy <= 0;
        end
    end
end

always @ (posedge clk) begin
    // Check for overflow
    if (acc > 16'hFFFF) begin
        ovf <= 1;
    end
    else begin
        ovf <= 0;
    end
end

endmodule
